{{Top|leg}}
'''Transpheres''' were two-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] bubbles made of [[transplas]]. Held aloft by a combination of [[Repulsor field/Legends|repulsor]] and [[tractor field]]s, the transpheres were used by attendees of the [[Unification Gala]] on [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] for zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gee]] dancing.<ref name="ES">{{WEGCite|story=The Event of the Season|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
